    • contextAware

      @Contract("_ -> new") static ErrorTracker contextAware(@Nullable ClassLoader classLoader)
      Creates a context-aware error tracker policy for the given class loader.

      The returned tracker has its error context attached immediately. If the class loader is null, the tracker will track all errors.

      Parameters:
      classLoader - the class loader whose errors should be tracked, or null to track all errors
      Returns:
      the error tracker policy
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the error context is already attached
      Since:
      0.24.0
      See Also:
      • attachErrorContext(ClassLoader)

    • ignoreError

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") ErrorTracker ignoreError(Class<? extends Throwable> type)
      Adds an error type that will not be reported to FastStats.

      Matching is done exactly. If, for example LinkageError was ignored, NoClassDefFoundError would still be reported, even though it extends LinkageError

      Parameters:
      type - the error type
      Returns:
      the error tracker
      Since:
      0.24.0

    • ignoreError

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") ErrorTracker ignoreError(Pattern pattern)
      Adds a pattern that will be matched against all error messages.

      If an error's message matches the given pattern, it will not be reported to FastStats. 

      // Exact match
tracker.ignoreError(Pattern.compile("No space left on device"));

// Regex match
tracker.ignoreError(Pattern.compile("No serializer for: class .*"));
      Parameters:
      pattern - the regex pattern to match against error messages
      Returns:
      the error tracker
      Since:
      0.24.0

    • ignoreError

      @Contract(value="_, _ -> this", mutates="this") ErrorTracker ignoreError(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Pattern pattern)
      Adds an error type combined with a message pattern that will not be reported to FastStats.

      An error is ignored only if its class matches the given type exactly and its message matches the given pattern. 

      tracker.ignoreError(IOException.class, Pattern.compile("No space left on device"));
      Parameters:
      type - the error type
      pattern - the regex pattern to match against error messages
      Returns:
      the error tracker
      Since:
      0.24.0

    • addExclusionRule

      @Contract(value="_ -> this", mutates="this") ErrorTracker addExclusionRule(BiPredicate<Thread, Throwable> rule)
      Adds a rule that excludes automatically tracked errors from being reported to FastStats.

      Rules are only applied to errors captured through an attached error context, after the error has been attributed to the tracker's class loader.

      If any rule returns true for the thread and error, the error is not tracked. 

      // Exclude all errors without a package frame from "your.package.name"
tracker.addExclusionRule((thread, error) -> {
  for (final var element : error.getStackTrace()) {
    if (element.getClassName().startsWith("your.package.name")) {
      return false; // track this error
    }
  }
  return true; // do not track this error
});
      Parameters:
      rule - the rule deciding whether an error on the given thread should be excluded
      Returns:
      the error tracker
      Since:
      0.31.0
      See Also:
      • attachErrorContext(ClassLoader)

    • detachErrorContext

      void detachErrorContext()
      Detaches the error context from the tracker.

      This restores the original uncaught exception handler that was in place before attachErrorContext(ClassLoader) was called.

      This should be called during shutdown to prevent BootstrapMethodError when the provider's JAR file is closed.

      Since:
      0.23.0

    • isSameLoader

      @Contract(pure=true) static boolean isSameLoader(Thread thread, ClassLoader loader, Throwable error)
      Checks if the error occurred in the same class loader as the provided loader, taking the context class loader of the given thread into account.

      In addition to the stack frame check of isSameLoader(ClassLoader, Throwable), the thread's context class loader must be either null, or be the given loader, one of its parents or one of its children.

      Parameters:
      thread - the thread the error occurred on
      loader - the class loader
      error - the error
      Returns:
      whether the error occurred in the same class loader
      Since:
      0.31.0
